facts.evidence: Consolidated Alphabet revenues reached $119.8 billion for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, representing a 24% increase (or 23% in constant currency).
Net income available to common stockholders increased 298% to $112.1 billion, with diluted net income per common share increasing 294% to $9.11.
Google Cloud revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion, driven by demand for enterprise AI solutions, enterprise AI infrastructure, and core Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services.
Google Services revenues grew 15% to $94.5 billion, supported by 17% growth in Google Search & other, 15% in Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices, and 13% in YouTube ads.
Consolidated Alphabet operating income increased 30% to $40.8 billion, with the operating margin expanding by 2 percentage points to 34%.

Other income for the quarter included a net gain of $98.0 billion, primarily from net unrealized gains on equity securities. (Note: the brief reports the gain and its source correctly, but omits the disclosed $6.26 per-share effect on diluted EPS.)

In June 2026, the company issued a combination of Class A stock, Class C stock, and mandatory convertible preferred stock for aggregate net proceeds of $49.6 billion for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures for AI infrastructure.

claims.claim: Alphabet reported a 24% increase in consolidated revenues to $119.8 billion for the second quarter of 2026.
Consolidated Alphabet revenues reached $119.8 billion for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, a 24% increase.
Revenue growth was 23% in constant currency.
Consolidated Alphabet operating income increased 30% to $40.8 billion.
Operating margin expanded by 2 percentage points to 34%.
Net income available to common stockholders increased 298% to $112.1 billion.
Diluted net income per common share increased 294% to $9.11.
Other income for the quarter included a net gain of $98.0 billion, primarily from net unrealized gains on equity securities.
Google Services revenues grew 15% to $94.5 billion.
Google Services growth was supported by 17% growth in Google Search & other, 15% in Google subscriptions, platforms, and devices, and 13% in YouTube ads.
Google Cloud revenues increased 82% to $24.8 billion.
Google Cloud growth was driven by demand for enterprise AI solutions, enterprise AI infrastructure, and core Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services.
Nearly 90% of the Fortune 100 are using Gemini Enterprise.
The release provides no specific guidance or outlook for future periods.
In June 2026, the company issued a combination of Class A stock, Class C stock, and mandatory convertible preferred stock for aggregate net proceeds of $49.6 billion.
The June 2026 equity proceeds are to be used for general corporate purposes, including capital expenditures for AI infrastructure.
The company issued senior unsecured notes in the second quarter of 2026 for net proceeds of $20.3 billion.
Total cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities were $242.5 billion as of June 30, 2026.
The release notes that fluctuations in the value of these equity investments can significantly contribute to the volatility of other income.
